definitions.gloss: to browse; to view; to inspect; to read through
definitions.explanation: To look through or read documents, websites, or materials. Originally used for inspecting official documents, now very common for browsing the internet.

examples.japanese: ウェブサイトを{閲覧|えつらん}する。
この{資料|しりょう}は{自由|じゆう}に{閲覧|えつらん}できます。
examples.english: These materials can be freely viewed.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}を{含|ふく}むページを{閲覧|えつらん}する{際|さい}は、セキュリティに{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: When browsing pages that contain personal information, please be careful about security.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form {閲覧|えつらん} is also widely used on its own, especially in compound words. In web contexts, {閲覧|えつらん} is the standard word for browsing or viewing content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウェブサイトを{閲覧|えつらん}する (to browse a website)
- {閲覧|えつらん}{履歴|りれき} (browsing history)
- {閲覧|えつらん}{数|すう} (page views)
- {閲覧|えつらん}{制限|せいげん} (viewing restriction)
- {閲覧|えつらん}{注意|ちゅうい} (viewer discretion advised)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {参照|さんしょう}する: to refer to — looking up specific information
- {検索|けんさく}する: to search — actively looking for something specific
